description.zh:
指定用户名。

长度为1~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
description.en:
The name of the RAM user.

The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

descriptions.zh: 删除用户前，需要保证用户不拥有任何权限且不属于任何用户组。
descriptions.en: Before you delete a RAM user, make sure that no policies are attached to the RAM user and that the RAM user does not belong to any groups.
